sentiment.finding: Best method: RoBERTa (twitter-sentiment) at macro-F1 0.643. NRC scores 0.446 against VADER's 0.527 — the richer lexicon is the weaker polarity method. NRC's value is its eight emotion categories, not its positive/negative split.

topics.summary: 18 topics over 52,089 captions, 19% outliers. On NPMI coherence, BERTopic wins: 0.472 vs 0.298.

model.note: The Phase-1 weighted index is flattered here — isotonically calibrated on the full dataset, an advantage the learned model does not get. It still loses by 0.469 R².

ablation.negative: Every pillar contributes. The largest single contributor is brandfit (+0.108 R² when removed).

price.negative: The learned price model reaches R² 0.975 against 0.966 for a published rate card with no learning at all — a gap of 0.010. That does not justify the maintenance cost. Ship the rule; revisit once real negotiated-deal data exists.
